meta.title: Shaded vendor fields cannot be filled by the buyer

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen with the default auction stage.
Provide the required event title for a create-screen test.
Apply a pricing template so the sheet and its locked vendor columns render.
Add a product row to the template table.
Assert that the buyer-facing Price vendor field is marked read-only, proving the shaded vendor field cannot be filled by the buyer.
